decisions.reason: DOI 10.1002/ar.20541 is inside the url= value https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/store/10.1002/ar.20541/asset/... of the Reidenberg citation template (Cite journal). That is a publisher URL whose path has no /doi/ segment, so guide 3.5 falls to 'anything else' and the raw text is the identifier text, which is what the locked quote holds. The URL is in url= of a citation and points at the identifier, so identifier_link fits the role table. The engine missed it; the locked label is right.
